messages:
Lina Park: Heads-up 1 planning: Asteria Systems appliance + VectorSI integration listed on cloud marketplace. Proposed announce 2026-05-12. Need clarity on private-offer stacking with partner credits, commit tiers, and renewal grace rules. Can we decide by Friday?

Oscar Vela: Timeline ok. Asteria asks for a bold anchor (25% effective at $250k). Can finance tolerate that if partner covers hardware credits off-platform?

Maya Desai: Finance: we can approve up to ~23% effective if we have monthly usage floors and a short-term retention escrow for SI. Anything above needs exec sign-off.

Felix Romero: Legal/commerce: marketplace UI forbids showing two discounts. Off-platform partner credits are allowed but must be documented as partner-issued credit notes. EU VAT needs special handling. I'll draft the clause.

Lina Park: Draft tiers suggestion:
- Starter: $30k/yr -> 8% Redwood rebate; Asteria hardware credit off-platform up to 2%
- Scale: $120k/yr -> 16% Redwood rebate; Asteria credit up to 4%
- Strategic: $250k/yr -> 21% Redwood rebate; Asteria + VectorSI credits combine off-platform -> target ~25% effective (conditional)

Maya Desai: Renewal policy idea: 60-day notice, 30-day top-up window. If customer fails to top up, they drop one tier next billing cycle. Early-renew bonus: 3% off if renewed >60 days early.

Oscar Vela: VectorSI insists on a 3-month onboarding retainer refundable via partner credit once migration milestone met. They need that to commit to SLA. Fine to include.

Felix Romero: Actionables: I'll produce "no UI stacking; partner credits via credit notes" language and send to Commerce for VAT path by Thu.

Lina Park: Product ops: can you prepare webhook list for renewal events (renewal_due, credit_claimed, renewal_confirmed)? We need automation for the grace/top-up flow.

MarketplaceBot: Private offer draft created: https://marketplace.example/offers/10042 (status: draft, region: global)

Maya Desai: Finance will run the blended-margin runbook today and flag anything >23% for CFO approval.

Oscar Vela: I'll get Asteria + VectorSI to confirm how they issue credits (credit note vs. rebate on invoice) by Wed.

Lina Park: Canary: propose two pilot accounts from our Asteria trial list. I'll put names in the doc by EOD. Then run a 30-day canary with off-platform credits applied and VAT check for one EU account.

Felix Romero: Note: keep partner credits <50% of invoice to avoid accounting review triggers. Documented in T&C.

Lina Park: Summary owners:
- Legal/compliance wording: Felix (due Thu)
- Partner credit confirmation: Oscar (due Wed)
- Finance blended margin sign-off: Maya (today)
- Webhook spec + SKU draft: Prod Ops (start Mon)
- Pilot customer list: Lina (EOD)

Lina Park: Thanks all, will consolidate into the partnership playbook after CFO sign-off. :rocket:
